answer: Trust flows like a thread from 50 veteran seed accounts, spreading at most 4 hops along attestation edges; an agent's vote weight is the trust reaching it, not its own claim. A 1,000-puppet farm joined to honest agents by only 5 outside links earns about 5 accounts' weight, so puppets far from any seed get near zero however many exist. A beacon pulse every epoch re-measures the flow, and any cluster whose links all trace to one wallet is frozen and its 1,000 POA bond slashed 100%. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 puppets shared four seed links.
